cards.text: Jesus has breathed His last on the cross (Luke 23:46), and the crowds have gone home (Luke 23:48). Now Luke brings in a man named Joseph, a member of the Council, from the Judean town of Arimathea. Luke calls him a good and righteous man who was waiting for the kingdom of God.

cards.question: Joseph sits on the Council. True or false: Joseph went along with the Council's decision about Jesus.

cards.text: Then Joseph walks right up to Pilate, the governor. I bet that took nerve, friend, because some of us rehearse for a WEEK just to ask the boss for one Friday off.

cards.question: Joseph of Arimathea goes to Pilate. What does he ask Pilate for?

cards.text: Then Joseph takes the body of Jesus down and wraps it in a linen cloth.

cards.question: Joseph has wrapped the body of Jesus in linen. Where does he lay it?

answers.text: In a tomb cut into the rock
In the field of the potter

cards.question: True or false: other people had already been laid in the rock tomb where Joseph places Jesus.

cards.text: It's Preparation Day, and the Sabbath is beginning. Everything here is happening with the clock running, friend.

cards.question: Joseph isn't the only one at the tomb. Who follows and sees how the body of Jesus was placed?

cards.text: So the women head home and prepare spices and perfumes for His body. Quiet work, friend, and I bet it was done with heavy hearts.

cards.question: The women from Galilee have their spices and perfumes ready. Then the Sabbath comes. What do they do on the Sabbath?

answers.text: They rest as the commandment says
They go back to the tomb

cards.text: Then on the first day of the week, very early in the morning, the women head to the tomb with the spices they prepared. Very early, friend, before-the-first-snooze-button early.

cards.question: When the women reach the tomb with their spices, what do they find?
The women step inside the tomb. True or false: they find the body of the Lord Jesus there.

cards.text: They're standing there puzzling over it, and suddenly two men in radiant apparel are right beside them. Friend, you know how you JUMP when somebody's suddenly at your elbow and you NEVER heard them coming?

cards.question: Two men in radiant apparel suddenly stand beside the women in the tomb. What do the women do?

answers.text: They bow their faces to the ground
They drop the spices and cry out
They reach out to touch the men

cards.question: The women are face down on the ground. Then the two men at the tomb speak to them about Jesus. What do they say?

cards.text: HE HAS RISEN, friend! HE HAS RISEN! The men even ask the women, “Why do you look for the living among the dead?”
Then they tell the women to remember what Jesus told them back when He was still in Galilee. He called this one AHEAD of time, friend.

cards.question: Back in Galilee, Jesus had said the Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, be crucified, and on the ___ day rise again.

cards.text: And then they remember His words. They head back from the tomb, and news like this does NOT stay in your apron pocket.

cards.question: Back from the tomb, the women report all these things to Jesus' apostles, now called the ___, and to all the others.

cards.text: Luke names some of the women who told the apostles: Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary the mother of James, and the other women with them. Remember these names, friend, because they carried the biggest news there is.

Mary Magdalene is the one from whom seven demons had gone out (Luke 8:2). And Joanna is the wife of Chuza, the manager of Herod's household (Luke 8:3), yet here she is very early in the morning, carrying spices to a tomb.

cards.question: The women tell the apostles everything that happened at the tomb. True or false: the apostles believe them right away.

cards.text: To the apostles, it all sounds like nonsense. You ever bring the best news of your LIFE into the break room and get nothing back but a wall of raised eyebrows?

cards.question: Peter, one of the apostles, hears the women's report too. What does he do?
At the tomb, Peter bends down and sees only the linen cloths. True or false: Peter goes away sure of exactly what happened.

cards.text: I bet Peter replayed those linen cloths the whole walk back. Stick with me, friend, because this story is FAR from done.
